skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze.rule: Remove up to 4 Guard from the effective recipient, then deal 9 plus level raw damage through any Guard that remains.

animationBeats.pose: The lament stops mid-drift and turns its full attention on the target, motionless.
The stare sharpens to a fixed point; the target's guarded stance visibly begins to waver.
A cold pressure crosses the space between them, bending the target's posture inward.
The target's guard breaks outward in dim, guttering shards rather than bronze light.
The pressure follows through as a raw blow the target has no composure left to absorb.
The lament lets the stare go and the air around it settles, ready again.

skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze.framing: Keep the full figure, both hands, the target line and the impact effect inside the battle safe frame for every beat.

text.firstObservation: The lament drifts the processional route it was never able to finish, mouth open on a mourning cry that never quite becomes sound.

intentTells.skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze: It stops its slow, wordless drift and turns a fixed, hollow stare on the weakest stance in the party -- the opening beat of a dread gaze.

art.framing: Entire translucent figure, the stare's direction and the guard-break effect remain inside the battle safe frame.
